DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この大きい封筒で書類をお送りになるのですね。特に気にかけていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send documents in this large envelope, correct? Is there anything in particular you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折りたくない原本です。「折曲厳禁」と書けば、小さい封筒でも折られずに送れるのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折りたくない原本で、折曲厳禁と書けば小封筒でも折れずに送れると思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: These are original documents that I do not want folded. I thought writing “Do not bend” might mean they could be sent without being folded even in a small envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that these are originals you do not want folded and that you thought a small envelope would still protect them from folding if marked “Do not bend.”

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注意書きだけで折れないことをお約束はできません。書類が入る大きさや、封筒の中の準備を先にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A warning alone does not let us promise that they will not be bent. Please first check that the envelope is large enough for the documents and that you have prepared the contents inside it appropriately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文字を書くだけでは足りないのですね。この大きい封筒を使い、原本の控えを残してから封をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注意書きだけでなく大封筒を使い、原本の控えを残してから封をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So simply writing a warning is not enough. I would like to use this large envelope, keep copies of the originals, and then seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use a large envelope as well as a warning and keep copies of the originals before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で内容を確かめてからにしましょう。配達状況を調べるための記録もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contents yourself before sealing it. Would you also like a record that lets you check the delivery status?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。発送した控えを残し、配達状況も調べたいです。書類の内容が正式に受け付けられたかは、提出先へ別に確認するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送控えと配達状況の確認を希望し、内容の正式受理は提出先へ別に確認する意向を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I would like to keep proof of posting and check the delivery status. I plan to ask the receiving organization separately whether the documents have been formally accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want proof of posting and delivery tracking and will separately ask the receiving organization about formal acceptance of the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二つは分けてください。ご希望の記録に対応する候補を確認します。料金は、準備後の大きさや重さも見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep those two matters separate. I will check the options that provide the records you want. We will explain the price after also checking the size and weight once your preparations are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒だけの重さで料金が決まるのではないのですね。中身と保護の準備を終えてから、重さを見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金は空封筒だけの重さではなく中身と保護準備後に計量して案内されると確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the price is not determined by the weight of the empty envelope alone. I will have it weighed after putting in the contents and finishing the protective preparations.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that the price will be explained after weighing the contents and protective materials, rather than just the empty envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。封をする前の内容確認はご自身でお願いします。取扱条件と料金の説明を聞いてから、差出し方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the contents yourself before sealing it. After hearing the handling conditions and prices, please choose how you would like to send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は原本の控えがまだないので、先に持ち帰って準備します。折らないための準備と追跡の希望をメモし、完成した封筒で方法と総額を相談し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控え未準備なので今日は持ち帰り、折らない準備と追跡希望を整理して完成封筒で方法と総額を再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I do not have copies of the originals yet, so I will take them home and prepare them first. I will note the protection against folding and tracking I want, then come back with the finished envelope to discuss the method and total cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take it home because you have not made copies yet, organize the protection and tracking you want, and return with the prepared envelope to discuss the method and total cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、封筒と原本をお返しします。準備が済んでから、記録の希望もあわせてお知らせください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-IBUSUKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your envelope and original documents back. Once everything is ready, please also tell us what records you would like. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現場へ行く前に、指示の聞き方を確認します。今の「待機してください」は、どういう意味だと思いましたか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you go to the worksite, let us check how to listen to instructions. What did you understand “Please stand by” to mean just now?

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の場所へ移動するという意味だと思いました。ここに残って待つということですか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待機を移動と受け取ったと伝え、今いる場所で待つ意味か聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought it meant to move to the next location. Does it mean to stay here and wait?
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understood “stand by” as an instruction to move, and ask whether it means to wait where you are.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、ここでは今いる指定場所で待つという意味です。聞き取れないまま動き始めないでください。現場で指示を出す人はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, here it means to wait in the designated place where you are now. Please do not start moving without understanding the instruction. Do you know who will give instructions at the worksite?

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先輩が二人いると聞きましたが、どちらが動物の担当者なのか、まだ知りません。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先輩二人のうち動物担当者が誰かまだ知らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard there are two senior coworkers, but I do not yet know which one is in charge of the animals.
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not yet know which of the two senior coworkers is responsible for the animals.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作業前に責任者から紹介してもらいましょう。近くにいる人なら誰でも同じ指示を出せる、とは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before work starts, please ask the person in charge to introduce you. Do not assume that anyone nearby is authorized to give the same instructions.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者を紹介してもらいます。もし二人から違うことを言われたら、自分でどちらか選んで進めないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者紹介を求め、違う指示を自分で選んで進めないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask to be introduced to the responsible person. If the two people give different instructions, I should not choose one myself and proceed, should I?
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to be introduced to the responsible person and confirm that you should not choose between conflicting instructions yourself and continue.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。安全な指定場所で止まり、責任者に指示を確かめます。図の矢印だけで動物への近づき方を判断してはいけません。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is right. Stop in a designated safe place and confirm the instructions with the person in charge. You must not decide how to approach an animal from the arrows in a diagram alone.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この図を見ただけでは、実際の立ち位置は決められないのですね。現場の担当者の説明と実演を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 図だけで立ち位置を決めず、現場担当者の説明と実演を受けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I cannot decide where to stand just by looking at this diagram. I would like the person responsible at the worksite to explain and demonstrate it.
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not choose your position from the diagram alone and want an explanation and demonstration from the person responsible at the worksite.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望を引き継ぎます。説明を聞いた後も、自分の理解を言い直して確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on that request. After hearing the explanation, can you repeat your understanding back to check it?

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。「今は指定場所で待ち、担当者の合図がわかってから動く」という理解で合っているか、その場で聞き返します。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定場所で待ち、担当者の合図を理解してから動くという理解を言い直して確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will ask on the spot whether I have understood correctly: “For now, I wait in the designated place and move only after I understand the responsible person's signal.”
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will repeat and confirm your understanding that you wait in the designated place and move only after understanding the responsible person's signal.

DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように確認してください。今日は教室での確認を終え、現場で担当者の紹介と説明を受けるところへつなぎます。
DLG-SC-KGS-KANOYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check it that way. We will finish today's classroom confirmation here and arrange for you to meet the responsible person and hear the explanation at the worksite.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レポートのための見学でしょうか。どの資料を調べていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you visiting for a report? Which item are you researching?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この道具を調べています。「年代不詳」とありますが、百年くらい前の物だと書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年代不詳の展示品を百年前と記してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am researching this tool. The label says “Date unknown,” but may I write that it is about a hundred years old?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may describe an exhibit of unknown date as being a hundred years old.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示では年代が特定できていません。百年前と決めず、年代不詳と記録してください。用途の説明も見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That label means its date has not been identified. Please record it as “Date unknown” rather than deciding that it is a hundred years old. Have you also looked at the explanation of its use?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 横の絵を見ました。この道具を使っている当時の写真ではなく、後から描いた説明図ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣の図が当時の写真でなく後から描かれた説明図か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked at the picture beside it. Is it an explanatory drawing made later, rather than a photograph of the tool being used at the time?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether the adjacent illustration is a later explanatory drawing rather than a contemporary photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、説明のために描いた図です。実際の使用場面を撮影した資料ではありません。図の下には「使い方の一例」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it is a drawing made to explain the tool. It is not photographic evidence of it actually being used. Under the illustration it says “One example of how it was used.”

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、誰もがこの方法で使ったと書かず、図は一例だと分けて説明します。展示札の言葉をメモしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用法は全員共通とせず一例と記し、展示札のメモ可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not write that everyone used it this way, and I will explain separately that the drawing shows one example. May I take notes of the wording on the exhibit label?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will describe the method as one example rather than universal practice, and ask whether you may take notes from the exhibit label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、通路をふさがずにメモしてください。展示番号も残すと、あとでどの資料か尋ねやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please take notes without blocking the passage. Recording the exhibit number will also make it easier to ask about the item later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号も書きます。展示札と自分の考えが混ざらないよう、引用した言葉にはかぎ括弧を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示番号も記録し、札の引用とかぎ括弧のない自分の考えを分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write down the number too. I will put quotation marks around the words I quote so that the label's explanation does not become mixed up with my own thoughts.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the exhibit number and distinguish quoted label wording in quotation marks from your own unquoted thoughts.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: よい整理方法ですね。まだ説明が不足していると感じる部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is a good way to organize your notes. Is there any part you still feel is not sufficiently explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 年代が不明な理由は、札だけではわかりません。その点は自分で理由を作らず、未確認の質問として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 年代不明の理由は札にないため作らず、未確認の質問として残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The label alone does not tell me why the date is unknown. I will not invent a reason myself; I will leave it as an unanswered question.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the label does not explain why the date is unknown, so you will not invent a reason and will keep it as an unanswered question.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その質問をお預かりします。追加資料があるかは担当者に確認しますので、今は札で確認できた内容と未確認の点を分けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take that question. I will ask the responsible staff member whether there are additional materials, so for now please separate what the label confirms from what is still unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 精肉売場でのご購入についてですね。どこが気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about a purchase from the meat counter, correct? What concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薄切り肉を三百グラム頼んだつもりですが、このパックには五百グラムとあります。注文内容を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三百グラムを頼んだつもりだが表示は五百グラムだと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I ordered three hundred grams of thinly sliced meat, but this pack says five hundred grams. I would like to check what was ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought you ordered three hundred grams but the label says five hundred grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品と購入時の記録を拝見します。お渡ししたときに、量の表示も確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will look at the product and the purchase record. Did you also check the quantity label when it was handed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 急いでいて見ていませんでした。レシートはありますが、頼んだ量を自分でメモしたものはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取り時に表示未確認で、レシートはあるが注文量の自分のメモはないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was in a hurry and did not look at it. I have the receipt, but I do not have my own note of the quantity I ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not check the label when receiving the meat and have a receipt but no personal note of the ordered quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、レシートと売場の記録を照合します。包装を開けたり、中身を使ったりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will compare the receipt with the counter's records. Have you opened the packaging or used any of the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けていません。昨日買ってから冷蔵庫に入れ、今朝、使う前に表示の違いに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で昨日購入後に冷蔵庫へ入れ、今朝使用前に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not opened it. I put it in the refrigerator after buying it yesterday and noticed the difference on the label this morning before using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it is unopened, was refrigerated after yesterday's purchase, and that you noticed the difference this morning before using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況を記録しました。ご希望は、量を確認したいということですか。それとも交換をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have recorded the situation. Would you like us to check the quantity, or are you requesting an exchange?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず注文の記録を知りたいです。三百グラムの注文だったと確認できた場合に、交換などの対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先に注文記録を確認し、三百グラム注文と確認できたら対応を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I would like to know what the order record says. If it confirms that the order was for three hundred grams, I would like to discuss an exchange or another possible response.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want the order record checked first and want to discuss a response if a three-hundred-gram order is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。現時点では原因と対応はまだ決まっていません。担当者への確認中は、商品をこちらでお預かりしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Neither the cause nor the response has been determined yet. May we hold the product here while we check with the responsible staff member?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、未開封のパックを預けます。私の記憶では三百グラムですが、記録の確認結果と対応できる内容を分けて説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封品を預け、自分の記憶と記録の結果、対応内容を分けて説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will leave the unopened pack with you. My recollection is that I ordered three hundred grams, but please explain the record-checking results separately from what action you can take.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the unopened product and ask in Japanese for your recollection, the record-checking results, and the available response to be explained separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品をお預かりしました。購入記録を確認し、わかった注文内容と、可能な対応を順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received the product. We will check the purchase record and explain the confirmed order details and then the possible responses in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ステージの入場券を拝見します。ご一緒の方もおそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I see your admission ticket for the stage performance? Is everyone in your party here?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は先に着きました。友人が二人分の券を持っています。この予約画面の画像だけで、私だけ先に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が二人分の券を持っていると説明し、予約画像だけで先に入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I arrived first. My friend has the tickets for both of us. Can I go in ahead of them with just this image of the booking screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your friend has both tickets and ask whether you may enter first using only the booking image.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画像には入場券本体が写っていません。こちらでは画像だけで入場済みにはできませんので、券を持つ方と一緒に受付へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This image does not show the actual admission ticket. We cannot admit you based on this image alone, so please come to reception together with the person who has the tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人を待ちます。大きな鞄を持っていますが、先に入口の横へ置いておいてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人を待つと決め、大きな鞄を入口横に置いてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will wait for my friend. I have a large bag; may I leave it beside the entrance first?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for your friend and ask whether you may leave your large bag beside the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口の横は通路です。そこには置かず、お持ちのまま待機場所でお待ちください。預かり設備はこの受付にはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The space beside the entrance is a passage. Please do not put it there; keep it with you while waiting in the waiting area. This reception desk has no luggage-storage facilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置き去りにはしません。鞄を持って待つので、友人が見つけやすく、列をふさがない場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鞄を置き去りにせず持って待つため、列を妨げない待合せ場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not leave it unattended. I will wait with the bag, so please tell me somewhere my friend can find me easily without my blocking the queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep your bag with you rather than leave it unattended, and ask for a meeting place that does not obstruct the queue.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あちらの待合せ表示の前でお待ちいただけます。入場待ちの列とは別です。友人の方に場所を伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can wait over there in front of the meeting-point sign. It is separate from the admission queue. Can you tell your friend where it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。「ステージ入口の列ではなく、待合せ表示の前」と送ります。着いたら二人で券を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口の列ではなく待合せ表示前と友人に伝え、二人で券を出すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will message them, “In front of the meeting-point sign, not in the queue at the stage entrance.” When they arrive, we will present our tickets together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend you are at the meeting-point sign rather than the entrance queue and that you will present your tickets together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。入場前に、公演中の撮影についてもこちらの案内をお読みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Before entering, please also read this guidance about taking pictures during the performance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここでは公演中の撮影は禁止なのですね。友人にも伝え、二人そろってから荷物を持って受付へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 公演中撮影禁止を読み取り、友人に伝えて荷物を持ち二人で受付へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: So photography is prohibited here during the performance. I will tell my friend too, and once we are both here, we will bring our bags back to reception together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the ban on photography during the performance in Japanese and say that you will inform your friend and return to reception together with your bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、券をお持ちのお二人でお越しください。公演中は撮影せず、鞄は通路にはみ出さないようにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please come together with the tickets for both of you. Do not take pictures during the performance, and keep your bag from protruding into the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の入力でお困りの点を教えてください。まだ実行前でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you are having trouble entering for the bank transfer. Have you not submitted it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ送っていません。家族の講習費を私の口座から払う予定ですが、案内に申込者名を入れるよう書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未送金で、自分の口座から家族の講習費を払い申込者名指定に迷うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not sent it yet. I plan to pay a family member's course fee from my account, but the instructions say to enter the applicant's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not transferred the money and are unsure about the applicant-name instruction when paying a family member's course fee from your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの欄に入力する指定なのか、案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the instructions so we can see which field they specify?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 欄の名前はありません。受取人の名前を家族の名前に直すという意味かと思いましたが、講習の主催者とは違う名前になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内に欄名がなく、受取人を家族名へ直す意味かと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They do not name a field. I wondered whether it means changing the recipient's name to my family member's, but that would be a different name from the course organizer's.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that no field is named and that you wondered whether you should change the recipient's name to your family member's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人名は、お金を受け取る相手の情報です。申込者名の指定とは分けて考え、勝手に受取人を書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The recipient's name is information about the person receiving the money. Please treat that separately from the applicant-name instruction and do not change the recipient on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受取人は変更しません。送る側の表示を変える必要があるのか、主催者に聞くということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人は変更せず、送る側の表示について主催者へ聞くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not change the recipient. So I should ask the organizer whether I need to change how the sender's name is displayed, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will not change the recipient and will ask the organizer about the sender-name display.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。申込番号も必要か、あわせて確認するとよいでしょう。表示を変更できるかどうかは、利用する振込方法でも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. It would also be helpful to check whether an application number is required. Whether that display can be changed also needs to be checked for the transfer method you use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、申込者名と申込番号の指定を主催者に聞いてから戻ります。その返事を見せて、使える方法と手数料も相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込者名と申込番号の指定を確認後、回答を見せて振込方法と手数料も相談したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will come back after asking the organizer how to enter the applicant's name and application number. May I show you their reply and discuss the available methods and fees too?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether, after confirming the applicant-name and application-number requirements, you may show the reply and discuss transfer methods and fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返事を確認しながら、ご利用方法と費用をご案内します。今の段階では、名義や入金の扱いを主催者に代わって確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the available methods and costs while checking their reply. At this stage, we cannot determine on the organizer's behalf how the names or payment will be treated.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は振込を実行しません。主催者の回答を持参して、受取先、送る側の表示、手数料を一つずつ確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今は実行せず、主催者回答後に受取先・送る側表示・手数料を別々に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not make the transfer today. I will bring the organizer's reply and decide only after separately checking the recipient, the sender-name display, and the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not execute the transfer now and will separately confirm the recipient, sender-name display, and fee after receiving the organizer's reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内と回答をそろえてから、入力する欄を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once you have both the instructions and their reply, let us check the fields to enter separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 屋外の観覧通路をご覧になる前に、順路でご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you look around the outdoor viewing walkway, is there anything you are unsure about on the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この先の「出口」は屋内の展望室に戻る扉ですか。それとも建物の外へ出てしまいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口表示が屋内展望室へ戻る扉か退館口か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is the “Exit” ahead a door back to the indoor observation room, or does it take me outside the building?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the exit sign means a door back to the indoor observation room or an exit from the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そちらは退館するための出口です。屋内の展望室へ戻る場合は、観覧通路の「展望室へ」の表示に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the exit for leaving the building. If you want to return to the indoor observation room, please follow the “To the observation room” signs on the viewing walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は屋内に残ります。窓越しに友人が見えた場所で、近くの扉から中へ戻れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者は屋内に残り、窓越しに見つけた近くの扉から戻れると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is staying inside. I thought that if I saw them through a window, I could go back inside through a nearby door.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your companion is staying indoors and you thought you could return through a door near a window where you saw them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの窓の近くでも中へ戻れるわけではありません。案内された順路を使ってください。ご一緒の方とは、屋内のどこで待ち合わせますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You cannot return inside near just any window. Please use the indicated route. Where indoors will you meet your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。窓はどれも似ているので、窓際というだけではわかりにくいですね。案内板の前に決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓際だけでは不明確なので屋内案内板前を合流場所にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: We have not decided yet. All the windows look similar, so simply saying “by the window” would not be clear. I would like to choose the information-board area.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that “by the window” is unclear, so you would like to meet in front of the indoor information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その案内板は屋内の入口脇にあります。先に同行者の方と場所を確認してから、屋外へ出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That information board is beside the indoor entrance. Would you like to confirm the location with your companion before going outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、先に伝えます。屋外で途中まで行って引き返したい場合も、「展望室へ」の表示を探せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先に友人へ場所を伝え、屋外途中から戻る場合の表示も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I will tell them first. If I go partway along the outdoor route and want to return, should I also look for the “To the observation room” signs?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend the location first, and confirm what signs to use if you want to return partway through the outdoor route.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この施設では一方通行の区間があります。逆に歩かず、近くの職員に戻りたいと声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Some sections of this facility are one-way. Please do not walk against the direction; tell a nearby staff member that you would like to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、屋外へ出る前に一方通行の区間を図で見せてください。友人には屋内入口脇の案内板で待つよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋外へ出る前に一方通行区間の図示を求め、屋内入口脇の合流点を友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please show me the one-way sections on a map before I go outside. I will tell my friend to wait at the information board beside the indoor entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see the one-way sections on a diagram before going outside, and say that you will tell your friend the meeting point beside the indoor entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの図で一方通行の区間をご説明します。戻りたいときは職員にお知らせください。同行者の方との場所の確認も済ませてからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain the one-way sections using this diagram. If you want to return, please tell a staff member. Please also confirm the meeting place with your companion before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらがお会計の明細です。確認したい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the itemized bill. Is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ランチセットの下にコーヒーが別に書かれています。セットとコーヒーを二重に払うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: セットの下に飲み物が別表示され、二重請求か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Coffee is listed separately under the lunch set. Am I being charged twice for the set and the coffee?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the drink listed separately beneath the set is a duplicate charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このコーヒーの行はセット内の品を示すもので、金額は零円です。セット価格は千二百円です。ほかに追加した品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This coffee line lists an item included in the set, and the amount is zero yen. The set costs twelve hundred yen. Did you order anything else in addition?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食後にプリンを一つ追加しました。それはセットには含まれず、三百円ということで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加プリン一つはセット外で三百円か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I added one pudding after the meal. Is it correct that it is not included in the set and costs three hundred yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether the one extra pudding is outside the set and costs three hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、プリンは三百円です。今回の合計は千五百円で、セット内のコーヒーに別料金は付いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the pudding is three hundred yen. Your total is fifteen hundred yen, with no separate charge for the coffee included in the set.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明細の意味がわかりました。コーヒーはいつでも無料という意味ではなく、今回のセットに一杯含まれるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: コーヒーは常時無料でなく今回セットに一杯含まれるという理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand the itemized bill now. It does not mean coffee is always free; one cup is included in this particular set, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that coffee is not always free, but one cup is included in this set.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。もう一杯ご注文の場合は、別の料金になります。追加をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is correct. If you order another cup, there will be an additional charge. Would you like another one?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追加はしません。今日はセット一つとプリン一つ、千五百円だけを会計したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コーヒー追加を断り、セット一つとプリン一つの千五百円を会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I do not want another one. Today I would like to pay only fifteen hundred yen for one set and one pudding.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline extra coffee in Japanese and say that you will pay fifteen hundred yen for one set and one pudding.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 千五百円のお会計で承ります。お支払い後、明細の付いたレシートをお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will be fifteen hundred yen. After payment, we can give you an itemized receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二千円札でお願いします。内容を確認したので、レシートとおつりを一緒に受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二千円札で払い、確認済みの明細付きレシートとおつりを受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please take this two-thousand-yen note. Now that I have checked the details, I will take the receipt and change together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will pay with a two-thousand-yen note and receive the checked itemized receipt together with your change.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二千円をお預かりしました。五百円のおつりとレシートです。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you; I have received two thousand yen. Here are five hundred yen in change and your receipt. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文を伺います。この盛合せでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take your order? Would you like this assorted platter?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、と言う前に量を聞きたいです。写真では小さく見えますが、一人用の小鉢ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真で小さく見える盛合せが一人用小鉢か、確定前に量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before I say yes, I would like to ask about the portion. It looks small in the picture; is it a small side dish for one person?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese, before confirming the order, whether the pictured assortment that looks small is a small side dish for one person.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは三種類を一皿に盛る、二人から三人で分ける量です。今日はお一人で召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It has three kinds of food on one plate and is enough for two or three people to share. Are you eating by yourself today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人です。三種類を小さく一つずつ頼むつもりでした。まだ調理を始めていなければ、注文を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で三種類を小さく頼むつもりだったと説明し、調理前なら変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am alone. I meant to order a small portion of each of the three kinds. If cooking has not started yet, I would like to change my order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are alone and intended small portions of three kinds, and say that you would like to change the order if cooking has not started.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ注文は通していません。盛合せを半分にすることはできませんが、同じ材料を使った単品の小鉢ならあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have not sent the order through yet. We cannot halve the assorted platter, but we have individual small side dishes made with the same ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、単品の小鉢を選びます。この中の煮物は、温かい料理ですか。それとも冷たい料理ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単品小鉢に切り替え、煮物が温かい料理か冷たい料理か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will choose an individual small side dish. Is this simmered dish served hot or cold?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to an individual side dish in Japanese and ask whether the simmered dish is hot or cold.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 煮物は温めてお出しします。もう一つの和え物は冷たい小鉢です。どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We warm the simmered dish before serving it. The other mixed dressed dish is a cold side dish. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 温かい煮物を一つにします。足りるか見てから追加したいので、和え物は今は頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 温かい煮物一つを選び、量を見て追加するので和え物は今頼まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have one hot simmered dish. I want to see whether it is enough before adding anything, so I will not order the dressed dish now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one hot simmered dish in Japanese and say that you will not order the dressed dish now because you will decide about additions after seeing the portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 煮物の小鉢を一つですね。飲み物も今お決めになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: One small simmered dish, then. Would you like to decide on a drink now too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲み物は水をお願いします。まず煮物一つで注文を確定し、追加するときはこちらから声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水と煮物一つで確定し、追加は自分から声をかけると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Water, please. I will confirm the order as one simmered dish for now, and I will call you myself if I want to add anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm an order of water and one simmered dish in Japanese, and say that you will call the staff yourself if you want to add anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。盛合せと和え物は注文に入れず、煮物の小鉢一つとお水をお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGS-KANOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The assorted platter and dressed dish will not be included in your order. I will bring one small simmered dish and water.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お入りになる前に、館内の案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the information about the facility before entering?

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。入浴の後に家族と合流するので、携帯で地図を撮っておきたいです。この先にある図を写そうと思っています。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入浴後の家族との合流用に、この先の館内図を携帯で撮るつもりだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am meeting my family after bathing, so I would like to photograph the map with my phone. I was planning to take a picture of the diagram further ahead.
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to photograph the facility map ahead with your phone to help meet your family after bathing.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先には撮影禁止の掲示があります。どの部分を知っておきたいか、こちらで伺えますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a no-photography notice further ahead. Could you tell me here which parts you need to know about?

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出口と待ち合わせる所です。動画を撮らなければよいという意味ではなく、写真も撮らないという掲示なのですね。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出口と待合せ場所を知りたく、動画だけでなく写真も禁止という表示か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: The exit and the meeting place. The notice means no still photos either, not just no videos, correct?
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to know the exit and meeting place, and confirm that the sign prohibits photographs as well as videos.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、写真も含む表示です。出口と待合せ場所なら、今こちらにある紙の図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the notice includes photographs. Let us check the exit and meeting place now using this paper map here.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、入る前に確かめたいです。家族は入浴しないので、私が戻る場所を同じ名前で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入浴しない家族へ同じ場所名を伝えるため、入る前に紙の図で確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, I would like to check before entering. My family is not bathing, so I want to tell them the same name for the place I will return to.
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check the paper map before entering so that you can give your non-bathing family members the same place name.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図では「受付前の待合せ場所」とあります。お帰りもこの受付前へ戻る予定として、ご家族と共有できますか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: This map calls it the “Meeting place in front of reception.” Can you tell your family that you plan to return to the area in front of this reception desk?

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族にはその名前を伝えます。携帯の写真を頼りにする代わりに、紙の図の出口と待合せ場所を囲んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ受付前の待合せ場所という名を伝え、写真の代わりに紙へ出口と場所を囲みたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my family that name. Instead of relying on a phone photo, may I circle the exit and meeting place on the paper map?
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family the name “Meeting place in front of reception” and ask in Japanese whether you may circle the exit and meeting place on paper instead of taking a photo.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの紙に印を付けてください。合流の予定が変わる場合は、お入りになる前にご家族へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please mark this sheet. If your meeting plans change, please let your family know before you go in.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二か所に印を付け、家族にも伝えました。撮影禁止の先へ地図を撮りに行かず、ここで場所を確認できました。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二か所を印付けして家族へ共有し、禁止の先へ撮影に行かず場所を確認できたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have marked the two locations and told my family. I was able to confirm the places here without going beyond the no-photography sign to photograph the map.
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have marked both places and informed your family, and confirmed the locations without going beyond the prohibition to take a photo.

DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 待合せ場所を共有できましたね。紙の図はこちらです。館内の掲示もご覧になり、分からない所は職員へお尋ねください。それでは、こちらで受付をいたします。
DLG-SC-KGS-KIRISHIMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have agreed on the meeting place with your family, then. Here is your paper map. Please also read the signs inside and ask a staff member if anything is unclear. Now we will handle your admission here.
